metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 JSON inspect/render tool in C++20 under `output/`.

Source files:
- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)

Verified with:

```bash
cd /workspace/output
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

I also smoke-tested render/inspect round trips for point format 6 with WKT CRS, legacy format 0 with GeoTIFF CRS, extra bytes metadata, and an internal waveform EVLR case.
